title: Token x domain factorized embedding Mirror address
hypothesis: For domain-conditioned embeddings formed by applying a small orthogonal view to one shared token table, domain-level Mirror angles preserve held-out token-domain combinations and require materially fewer complete payload bytes than per-domain dense transforms and independent tables, while outperforming simple FiLM and hard sharing.
physical_object: One fixed 128x16 shared token embedding table. Eight domains use one domain address and one functional transformation to form 1,024 logical domain-token embeddings.
mirror_coordinate: Eight disjoint 2D Givens angles per domain, learned only on observed token-domain pairs; apply the resulting orthogonal transform to the shared token vector.
logical_multiplicity: Eight domain-specific functions over 128 token embeddings (1,024 logical embedding outputs) reconstructed from one shared table plus 64 domain angles.
prior_art_delta: PA59 compositional embeddings factor addresses into shared components. This experiment fixes the token table and tests the domain factor as an additional functional Mirror view; it audits unseen token-domain combinations and compares with hard sharing, FiLM, dense linear domain transforms and independent embeddings.

methods: independent per-domain per-token embedding oracle (all pairs; storage upper bound, not held-out generalization evidence)
hard shared token embedding with no domain view
shared token embedding plus per-domain FiLM scale and shift
shared token embedding plus one dense 16x16 linear transform per domain
shared token embedding plus eight learned Givens Mirror angles per domain

teacher.shared_table: A fixed seeded 128x16 token table is charged in all shared-table methods.
teacher.domain_functions: Eight-domain teacher applies eight disjoint 2D Givens rotations to each token vector. The first domain is the identity anchor; remaining teacher angles are seeded random values. No private token-domain residual is present.
teacher.split: A deterministic seeded 80/20 split of token-domain pairs, stratified to retain at least one observed domain per token and at least one observed token per domain. Train only shared-table methods on observed pairs; report train and held-out separately.
teacher.task_quality: A fixed seeded 16x16 decoder maps teacher embeddings to 16 classes. Report embedding NRMSE and classifier NLL/top-1 separately on observed and held-out pairs.
teacher.oracle_boundary: The independent per-domain embedding oracle stores all teacher pairs and is a full-quality storage upper control only. It is not used as evidence of held-out generalization and receives no role in model selection.

controls: full independent domain-token embedding oracle, all targets

development.selection_metric: Held-out token-domain embedding NRMSE is primary; held-out decoder NLL/top-1, observed-pair quality, exact payload bytes, active compute and wall-clock are secondary.
development.allowed_tuning: No tuning planned. Fixed table, teacher, split rule, optimizer and schedule. Any implementation correction may rerun development only before fresh access.

fresh.open_gate: Both development worlds: Mirror held-out NRMSE <=0.03; dense-transform held-out NRMSE <=0.03; Mirror within 0.005 held-out NRMSE of dense control; Mirror payload <=0.50x dense-transform payload and <=0.25x full oracle payload; Mirror improves held-out NRMSE over FiLM by >=0.01 and hard sharing by >=0.05; no quality collapse on observed pairs; all methods' saved state replays exact metrics. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
fresh.fresh_success: All three fresh worlds meet held-out fidelity, dense-comparator, simple-control, payload and exact-replay gates.

storage.authority: actual compressed NPZ inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: shared 128x16 token table or full 8x128x16 oracle table
domain Givens angles, FiLM scales/shifts or dense transforms
storage.deterministic_reconstruction: Domain/token indices and the eight Givens plane locations are determined by dimensions and fixed order; no learned pair-address table is stored.

success_gate: All fresh held-out quality, dense comparator, simple-control improvement, complete-payload and replay requirements pass.
failure_gate: Any development held-out quality, dense-comparator, simplicity or payload gate fails.
boundaries: synthetic domain-conditioned embedding screen; no recommendation or language-model evidence
shared token table is fixed to isolate the domain-view effect
no private token-domain residuals or domain retrieval are evaluated
the independent all-pair oracle is a storage/quality upper control and is excluded from held-out generalization claims
fixed update budget is not a capacity claim
